attempts.why: Inter Display is not a guaranteed system font with no fallback, so at 1200px the hero/probe text falls back to serif and renders at 292px instead of the intended system-ui metrics 317px; adding a proper fallback stack restores the correct visual metrics without hiding content.

selfVerify.reason: probe matches reference at 317px (not 292px serif fallback) indicating fallback stack applied correctly, docScrollWidth 1200 equals viewport 1200 with no horizontal overflow and all major layout boxes within viewport, so visual bug is restored without breakage.
